status_vocabulary.BEWIESEN: A mathematical or logical result follows from explicitly stated premises, or a software invariant is exhaustively established within its declared code contract. This does not by itself establish physical truth.
status_vocabulary.NUMERISCH_BESTAETIGT: Independent numerical implementations or regression anchors agree within declared tolerances over the tested domain.
status_vocabulary.KONDITIONAL: The statement follows only after adopting a stated model, reduction, approximation, boundary condition or unverified parent assumption.
status_vocabulary.HEURISTISCH: The statement is an analogy, visualization, phenomenological guide or exploratory construction without a complete derivation.
status_vocabulary.OFFEN: The required derivation, data identification, theorem, computation or source binding has not been established.
status_vocabulary.FALSIFIZIERT_ODER_BLOCKIERT: A counterexample exists, or a required gate/map is deliberately unavailable and the inference is forbidden.
status_vocabulary.NICHT_WISSENSCHAFTLICHER_CLAIM: Navigation, project description, governance state or user-interface text without an independent physical proposition.

claim_families.title: Standard FLRW background reference
claim_families.precise_claim: The canonical public engine implements LCDM and constant-w FLRW background functions with Omega_k=1-Omega_r-Omega_m-Omega_DE and fail-closed E^2>0 domain checks.
claim_families.validity_domain: z>=0, 0<a<=1, declared parameter domains; homogeneous isotropic background only
falsifiers: Failure of normalization E(0)=1 for a flat reference
Disagreement with independent FLRW reference integration
Acceptance of nonpositive or nonfinite E^2 as a real background

claim_families.title: Curvature-aware cosmological distance chain
claim_families.precise_claim: The public engine distinguishes radial comoving distance D_C from transverse comoving distance D_M and derives D_L and D_A through the FLRW curvature map.
claim_families.validity_domain: FLRW background and declared redshift domain
falsifiers: D_M not approaching D_C as Omega_k approaches zero
Violation of Etherington reciprocity inside the declared metric/light-propagation assumptions

claim_families.title: Linear GR growth reference
claim_families.precise_claim: LCDM and constant-w public reference paths solve the scale-independent linear pressureless-matter GR growth equation and display D, f and f sigma8.
claim_families.validity_domain: Linear pressureless matter perturbations in GR with smooth LCDM or constant-w dark energy; no released HZT perturbation map
falsifiers: Failure of the Einstein-de Sitter D=a and f=1 limit
Disagreement with an independent ODE integration
Use of this equation for the Bridge path without a released perturbation contract

claim_families.title: Reduced effective Bridge background
claim_families.precise_claim: Compare Safe implements the reduced diagnostic background E_B^2=E_LCDM^2[1+beta_tau I_B exp(-(a/a_c)^2)] with a_c=Rchi/(Rchi+2.5), Rchi>0.
claim_families.validity_domain: Reduced background-only diagnostic; Rchi>0; 1+Delta>0; no independent constant-w Bridge parent contract
falsifiers: Violation of the exact small-Rchi asymptotic a_c/Rchi->0.4
Failure of equal-product beta_tau I_B background identity
not_established: Derivation from the six-dimensional parent sector

claim_families.title: beta_tau times I_B product degeneracy
claim_families.precise_claim: Within the currently implemented Bridge background channel, beta_tau and I_B enter only through their product A_B=beta_tau I_B, so the corresponding local Jacobian subblock has rank at most one.
equations: partial O/partial beta_tau=I_B partial O/partial A_B
partial O/partial I_B=beta_tau partial O/partial A_B
falsifiers: A released independent observable whose derivatives with respect to beta_tau and I_B are not collinear
A changed model contract in which beta_tau and I_B enter separately
not_established: separate physical interpretation of beta_tau and I_B

claim_families.title: Bridge perturbation, growth and lensing firewalls
claim_families.precise_claim: No Bridge growth, Poisson, slip or lensing map is released; requests must fail closed rather than borrowing the GR reference equation.
falsifiers: A separately reviewed and released perturbation/observable map with source, equations, code and tests
claim_families.forbidden_inference: A defined H(z) background determines growth, lensing, mu(k,z), Sigma(k,z) or eta(k,z).

claim_families.title: HZT-M0 parent to reduced to observable forward map
claim_families.precise_claim: The full parent-to-reduced-to-observable map across rotation curves, background cosmology, growth, lensing and gravitational waves is not closed.
closure_conditions: Versioned parent equations and boundary conditions
Reduced variables derived rather than fitted by label
Observable maps for all declared channels
claim_families.forbidden_inference: A good reduced background fit derives the parameters from the six-dimensional parent theory.

claim_families.title: Physical background, response rank and ghost freedom
claim_families.precise_claim: No authorized physical background solution, physical response-rank result, global M1 existence theorem, continuum BVP invertibility proof or full ghost-freedom result is established.
required_evidence: Physical background existence and boundary-condition verification
claim_families.forbidden_inference: Numerical convergence or a green CI workflow establishes physical existence or ghost freedom.

claim_families.title: Observational data and likelihood provenance
claim_families.precise_claim: Public Observatory and Compare points/curves are diagnostic or didactic unless a versioned data vector, covariance, selection function, nuisance model and likelihood are explicitly bound.
falsifiers: A source-backed likelihood showing the displayed model fails the bound data under declared assumptions
claim_families.forbidden_inference: Visual curve proximity is a fit, evidence or theory confirmation.

claim_families.title: Cellular automaton and cosmology separation
claim_families.precise_claim: The Emergence cellular automaton is dynamically independent of the canonical LCDM background/growth overlay; display resampling does not mutate the simulation lattice.
claim_families.validity_domain: Software state transition and rendering contract
falsifiers: Different next cell hash for identical cell state/rule/noise under different cosmology display modes
Mutation of N or cells by displayN
not_established: Cell states as physical density perturbations
Cosmic structure formation from the automaton

claim_families.title: Prospective HZT observables and falsifiers
claim_families.precise_claim: RAR/rotation curves, expansion history, growth, lensing and gravitational-wave channels are research targets; they are not simultaneous released HZT predictions until their parent-to-observable maps are closed.
required_release_conditions: Data and likelihood provenance where empirical
claim_families.forbidden_inference: Mentioning a measurable channel is equivalent to predicting its amplitude, spectrum or parameter dependence.

claim_families.title: Public research status and authorization state
claim_families.precise_claim: Current public status pages report technical, governance and scientific axes separately and defer current authority to the manifest and dated current-state registries.
claim_families.forbidden_inference: A governance status is a physical measurement or theory result.

claim_families.title: FM-0 work programme and blocking gaps
claim_families.precise_claim: FM-G0 remains open with ten blocking gaps, of which three are partially resolved and seven fully unresolved; this is project-state accounting, not physical evidence.
claim_families.forbidden_inference: Closing project tasks demonstrates the physical theory.

claim_families.title: Educational, navigational and visual material
claim_families.precise_claim: Guides, journey pages, about pages, 3D views, portals and navigators may explain or visualize concepts but do not independently establish physical claims.
claim_families.required_qualifier: Educational or visualization context must not be phrased as empirical confirmation or parent derivation.
claim_families.forbidden_inference: A visual or narrative representation is an observable, simulation validation or physical proof.

claim_families.title: Historical, archived and legacy pages
claim_families.precise_claim: Archived audits, legacy routes and historical narratives are provenance records and cannot override current dated registries or the current manifest.
claim_families.forbidden_inference: A historically green or permissive artifact is the current operative state.
